artifacts.summary: Phase 5 (attempted, BLOCKED): added four sorry-free, axiom-clean theorems mechanizing that cs5Incest (@cs5CanonMreach Atom) is FALSE for the Phase-3-landed CS5CanonSegment world type, rather than landing the (impossible) positive lemma the plan specified. cs5CanonMreach_to_univ: the exploding world (head = Set.univ) is cs5CanonMreach-reachable from every canonical world. cs5Incest_cs5CanonMreach_forces_univ: IF cs5Incest held, every canonical world's head would equal Set.univ (since boxInv's monotonicity means no ≤-extension of a world can ever help satisfy the incestuality goal -- extending only ADDS boxed formulas, never removes the obstructing one, so the mediating witness u' is forced to equal u, collapsing the goal to plain unmediated symmetry). cs5_consistent_incest: CS5 is consistent (bot is not derivable), proved via a trivial one-point model (World := Unit, r/val always True, botForces always False) and Phase 4's landed cs5_soundness_derivable_incest/cs5FCIncest (reused unchanged, not modified). cs5Incest_cs5CanonMreach_false: combines the two for an outright contradiction from cs5Incest cs5CanonMreach, via quasi_head_realization producing a genuine non-exploding canonical world. This is a distinct, new obstruction (not the Phase 1 negation-completeness wall recurring) -- confirmed via grep that the counterexample proof contains no negation-completeness move.

Phase 5 marked [BLOCKED] with full blocker documentation: what failed (the literal Phase 5 goal is false), what was tried (the plan's own Lindenbaum-extension technique, shown powerless via a monotonicity argument; the Simpson F2-style multi-formula technique, shown not to bridge the gap without negation-completeness; the mechanized counterexample itself), why it's stuck (the unrestricted CS5CanonSegment world type admits a universally-reachable exploding world), and what is needed to unblock (two design options: a CS4Segment-style hereditary world-type restriction, task 508 precedent; or a cs4FC'-style existential weakening of cs5Incest, also task 508 precedent) -- both requiring a new planning round with explicit human authorization per the dispatch's hard constraints on reworking Phase 4's landed cs5FCIncest without approval.

metadata.blocker_summary: cs5Incest (@cs5CanonMreach Atom) is mathematically FALSE for the unrestricted CS5CanonSegment world type landed in Phase 3, due to the universally-reachable exploding world (head = Set.univ) which no ≤-mediated witness can route back from. This is NOT the Phase 1 negation-completeness wall recurring -- it is a distinct, purely set-theoretic obstruction (monotonicity of boxInv defeating any extension-based construction), mechanized as a complete, sorry-free, axiom-clean negative result rather than forced through or left with sorry. Requires human decision on one of two unblock paths (restrict the world type per the CS4Segment/task-508 precedent, or weaken cs5Incest to an existential clause per the cs4FC'/task-508 precedent) before Phase 5 can be re-attempted; Phase 6/7 cannot proceed until this is resolved.
